title: Naturality of the actual projection/counit tower map and its transpose
statement: Let ell be prime and E a finite extension of Q_ell. Use the normalized strict varying-coefficient tower categories, tensor calculus, compactification projection and full constructible finite-Tor subcategories. Let f=j followed by p be an open/proper factorization, let F be its compact-support functor on the full tower category with right adjoint G, and assume the coefficient unit lies in that category. Fix normalized tensor structures on source and target. Put omega=G(unit), Q_K=pull(K) tensor omega. Assume each Q_K belongs to the full subcategory and each specified projection for (omega,K) is invertible. Then the actual projectionCounit composite is natural in arbitrary maps K to L, and its actual adjunction transpose tensorMate is natural in the same maps. Both equations hold in the ambient ordinary derived category of towers before any finite evaluation. No orientation, geometric smoothness, or algebraic-closure hypothesis is needed. The notation and specified arrows are the shared words [def-sp-tensor-transpose-evaluation-words], built from the tower, tensor, projection, adjunction and normalized coefficient notions in the statement dependencies.

source.place: (2), factorwise naturality before evaluation and naturality of the actual adjunction transpose

proof.text:
Abbreviate $F=F_\bullet$, $G=G_\bullet$, $\omega=\omega_\bullet$ and write $\sigma$ for tensor symmetry. By [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels](2), the tensor operations and specified projection transformation are actual tower-derived operations and maps. Put $P_K=\operatorname{PF}_{f,\omega,K}:F\omega\otimes^LK\to F(\omega\otimes^Lf^*K)$. Its invertibility is an explicit hypothesis. With $r_K:K\otimes^L\mathbf1_Y\to K$, the map in the statement is precisely
$$h_K=r_K(1_K\otimes\varepsilon_{\mathbf1_Y})\sigma_{F\omega,K}P_K^{-1}F(\sigma_{f^*K,\omega}).$$
All factors exist before evaluation. For $u:K\to L$ put $q_u=f^*u\otimes1_\omega:Q_K\to Q_L$. Naturality of the specified transformation [def-exchange-projection] gives
$$F(1_\omega\otimes f^*u)P_K=P_L(1_{F\omega}\otimes u).$$
Multiplying by the two inverses gives the corresponding equation for $P^{-1}$. Substitution in the displayed formula, using naturality of symmetry and the unitor, yields $h_LF(q_u)=u h_K$. Thus $h$ is a natural tower morphism.

source.place: (2), factorwise naturality before evaluation and naturality of the actual adjunction transpose

proof.text:
The hypothesis $Q_K\in\mathcal C_X$ permits application of the adjunction of [det-sp-tower-gluing]. Define $t_K=G(h_K)\eta_{Q_K}$ in that category, hence in the ambient derived category because the subcategory is full. This is the adjoint transpose: naturality of the counit and the triangle identity give
$$\varepsilon_KF(t_K)=\varepsilon_KFG(h_K)F(\eta_{Q_K})=h_K\varepsilon_{FQ_K}F(\eta_{Q_K})=h_K.$$
For $u:K\to L$, Step 1 and naturality of the unit give
$$G(u)t_K=G(u h_K)\eta_{Q_K}=G(h_L)GF(q_u)\eta_{Q_K}=G(h_L)\eta_{Q_L}q_u=t_Lq_u.$$
These equalities establish naturality inside the tower derived category itself.

theorem tensor_transpose_tower_naturality :
    (∀ (K L : SpTowerCalculus.C l E b q Y) (v : K ⟶ L),
      (SpTowerShriek.F l E b o (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p)).map ((SpTowerGamma.tensorSource l
        E b o q (j ≫ p) ((SpTowerGamma.exceptional l E b q G).obj ⟨SpTowerGamma.originalUnit l E b q
        Y, hU⟩)).map v) ≫
          SpTowerGamma.projectionCounit l E b o q (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p) tx ty hF G adj hU
            L (hpf L) =
        SpTowerGamma.projectionCounit l E b o q (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p) tx ty hF G adj hU K
          (hpf K) ≫
          (SpTowerGamma.realization l E b q Y).map v) ∧
    (∀ (K L : SpTowerCalculus.C l E b q Y) (v : K ⟶ L),
      (SpTowerGamma.tensorSource l E b o q (j ≫ p) ((SpTowerGamma.exceptional l E b q G).obj
        ⟨SpTowerGamma.originalUnit l E b q Y, hU⟩)).map v ≫
          SpTowerGamma.tensorMate l E b o q (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p) tx ty hF G adj hU L (hQ
            L) (hpf L) =
        SpTowerGamma.tensorMate l E b o q (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p) tx ty hF G adj hU K (hQ
          K) (hpf K) ≫
          (SpTowerGamma.exceptional l E b q G).map v)
